description: Planted falsifiers. SPEC 18: at least one defect per proof family, and the corresponding checker must fail.

falsifiers.plants: formalProof level without a Lean declaration
citing the Atlas seal's cover check as universal coverage
falsifiers.expectedRejector: AT-001 scope-blindness lemma plus AT-002 absence check
falsifiers.note: Fails if Atlas.seal_implies_universal_coverage is supplied without a real proof, or if the blindness lemma that makes its absence principled is removed.

falsifiers.plants: a stale .olean masking a root module that does not elaborate
falsifiers.note: Regression guard. This defect really occurred: lakefile used globs .submodules, which never builds the root, so `lake build` reported green while two modules declared clashing Fault types.

Guards the property that makes GlobalOptimal meaningful: the competitor universe must be defined without reference to the artifact it will be compared against. Otherwise the theorem is a statement about a universe built around its own answer.

falsifiers.plants: a manifest stage containing its own identity, or a backward reference between stages
falsifiers.note: SPEC 4 requires the identity stages be acyclic: no manifest contains its own identity and no two stages hash each other. A cyclic manifest could be made to attest to itself.

note: A mutation suite that merely expects runtime output differences does not test universal-coverage integrity (SPEC 18). M4 and M6 target claim integrity directly.
